findings.description: Permission color lookup via theme.colors.permission[code] is wrong. Theme keys are bypass/readOnly/safeYolo but actual metadata codes are bypassPermissions/read-only/safe-yolo (confirmed in modelModeOptions.ts:48-72). Direct dynamic indexing also fails TS strict mode. Existing app already special-cases this in AgentInput.tsx:1388-1396.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: added explicit permissionColorForCode() helper section with full code, called out theme-key/metadata-code mismatch as critical, updated implementation strategy step 4 and acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a local helper permissionColorForCode(code: string | null | undefined): string that maps metadata code keys to theme.colors.permission.* values explicitly. Model after AgentInput.tsx:1388-1396 mapping.

findings.sectionRef: Approach > Implementation Strategy (step 5) and Files to Create
findings.description: Test mock list is incomplete. SessionsList.tsx imports expo-router, react-native-safe-area-context, useVisibleSessionListViewData, useIsTablet, requestReview, UpdateBanner (which pulls more hooks), StyledText (which pulls react-native-reanimated). Vitest evaluates the whole module on import, so mocking only Avatar/StatusDot/navigation will fail with import errors before the test runs.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: expanded test mock list in Implementation Strategy step 5 to cover ~25 module-scope imports including transitive ones (react-native-reanimated via StyledText, UpdateBanner deps, expo-router, expo-store-review, expo-image, etc.).
findings.suggestedFix: Expand the mock list to cover ALL module-scope imports of SessionsList.tsx (lines 3-23): expo-router, react-native-safe-area-context, expo-store-review, @/components/UpdateBanner, @/components/StyledText, @/hooks/useIsTablet, @/sync/storage, @/hooks/useVisibleSessionListViewData, react-native-reanimated. Provide working stubs for each.

findings.description: Pill row layout constraints are underspecified. Without minWidth:0, flexShrink, numberOfLines={1}, ellipsizeMode on text pills, narrow mobile rows will wrap or overflow. 'Adjust if wraps' is too late for autonomous implementation.
findings.resolution: Plan amended directly with all consensus findings.
findings.suggestedFix: Specify explicit pill layout constraints in the plan: each pill flex:0, minWidth:0, flexShrink:1; pill Text uses numberOfLines={1} and ellipsizeMode='tail'; container View uses flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', gap:6, overflow:'hidden'.

findings.description: 'Three identifiable pill elements' is vague. Snapshot serializer captures tree structure; need concrete identifiers (testID or text content) to make assertions verifiable.
findings.resolution: Plan amended directly with all consensus findings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add specific acceptance criteria: model pill renders text 'codex' (after formatModelCode on 'gpt-5-codex'); permission pill renders text 'plan'; flavor pill renders an expo-image Image with testID='session-role-pill-flavor'. Optionally add testIDs to all three pills for stable assertions.

findings.description: Layout acceptance is too subjective. Row height bump (88→108) is a guess and visual conditions (no clipping, no overlap with statusRow, no empty spacer when all three fields absent) are never converted to verifiable requirements.
findings.resolution: Plan amended directly with all consensus findings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add concrete criteria: when all three metadata fields are null, the pill row container is not rendered (no empty spacer); when all three are present, pills render single-line with truncation rather than wrapping; statusRow remains visible and not overlapped. Test the all-absent case as a second snapshot.

findings.description: Plan chooses raw-code rendering, but SessionContextDrawer resolves display names via getAvailablePermissionModes + resolvePermissionModeForPicker. For known modes (bypassPermissions->'Yolo', read-only->'Read Only'), raw rendering regresses UX. The acceptance test's 'plan' literal happens to match either approach.
findings.resolution: Plan amended directly with all consensus findings.
findings.suggestedFix: Either (a) resolve permission labels via getAvailablePermissionModes(flavor) when a matching option exists and fall back to raw code otherwise — drawer parity — or (b) document the raw-rendering decision as explicit v1 simplification with a follow-up to add label resolution. Pick one and state it in the plan.

findings.description: Snapshot test importing the full SessionsList.tsx module is more brittle than a structural assertion (findAllByType / findByProps). ActiveSessionsGroupCompact.test.tsx favors structural assertions over snapshots.
findings.resolution: Plan amended directly with all consensus findings.
findings.suggestedFix: Optional: keep a single snapshot test for the 'three pills present' case but ALSO add structural assertions for testIDs / text content to make the test robust against unrelated tree changes.
